criteria.requirement: Fix TreeInterpreter.visit_literal so mutable JSON literal results cannot mutate the cached parsed expression or later searches. Deeply detach object/array literal nodes on each evaluation, including literals nested in multi-select/projections and custom functions. Preserve scalar literal values, input field identity semantics, parser cache use and existing equality/type rules. Do not deepcopy every input document or purge compilation caches as a workaround.
